prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: soft violet. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: soft violet.
Subjects: a paper calendar page; the checklist.
Opens on the checklist, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the checklist folds into a single calendar page that drops to centre and holds.
Ends holding on the calendar page.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "Q2 2026".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "Q2 2026". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Strategy updates land in the second quarter of twenty twenty-six.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a cinematic, live-action modern editorial paper collage, photographed flat under soft room light. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, featuring a soft violet block-color paper ground. In the upper third, a cream-colored paper chip with a small soft shadow cast to the bottom-right contains the bold black sans-serif text "EXECUTION MILESTONES". In the lower two-thirds, a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a checklist with a checkmark sits on the ground, characterized by rough white torn-paper edges and a subtle shadow. An English narrator (S1), a male with a warm, clear, and natural mid-range timbre and a brisk but unhurried speaking rate, begins speaking immediately: <d>[English] Strategy updates land in the second quarter of twenty twenty-six.</d> Simultaneously, the "EXECUTION MILESTONES" chip slides rapidly off the top edge of the frame. The checklist cutout below quickly folds and collapses into a single, blank, unmarked paper calendar page cutout. This calendar page drops to the center of the frame with a slight overshoot before landing stably. As the calendar page settles, a new cream-colored paper chip slides in from the top, landing in the upper third of the frame. This chip features the large, extra-bold black sans-serif text "Q2 2026", which remains clean, legible, and stable. The camera remains in a Static Shot throughout. Every element—the violet ground, the halftone cutouts, and the paper chips—maintains a consistent matte printed paper texture with no glow or neon effects. The video ends holding on the final composition of the "Q2 2026" headline and the blank calendar page.

overall_soundscape: The audio features a crisp, tactile paper-slap sound as the chips slide and the checklist folds, accompanied by the subtle, sticky sound of tape being pressed down. These foley effects are layered beneath the clear, dry vocal delivery of the narrator.
